booking.source: recreation.gov facility 232174 (all 13 catalogued sites Site-Specific reservable; rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14); FS page ('Some sites can be reserved online ... Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis')

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); recreation.gov rates $30 every site type, 2026 and 2027; notice 'Site fee includes one RV with tow vehicle, tent sites include two vehicles. If space allows a third vehicle would be an additional fee'

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog: 13 sites - 8 STANDARD NONELECTRIC (RV/Trailer 40 ft site 11; 35 ft sites 6, 10, 12, 14, 15, 19; 25 ft site 9), 5 TENT ONLY; every driveway Back-In gravel. All 8 standard sites take 23 ft+.

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); recreation.gov ('Accessible restrooms and drinking water are provided. There are no showers or a dump station')

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October; recreation.gov sells 2027 nights May 20 to October 11.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'Mid-May to Mid-October'); recreation.gov rates ('Peak Season 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11')

discounts.source: FS page ('America the Beautiful Golden Age Passport, Golden Access Passport, Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: On NH-113 in Evans Notch, about 15 miles north of Fryeburg, ME, in mixed hardwoods a short walk from 23-acre Basin Pond (car-top boat launch, non-motorized boats, trout fishing). The 4.5-mile Basin Trail leaves from the campground. Two pets per site. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 232174: 13 sites (8 standard RV 25-40 ft, all fit 23 ft; 5 tent), $30 + $6 extra vehicle, vault toilets and water, no showers or dump, mid-May to mid-October, all catalogued sites reservable with 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums. Not waterfront confirmed (~80 m under forest). Status open stands (manual, not touched).
flags: STATUS: manual 'open' left alone; consistent with recreation.gov (2026 and 2027 seasons on sale) and the FS page (no closure notice, last updated August 3, 2026). The construction caveat in curation_note is now history.
sites.max_rig_ft 30 -> 40 (site 11 RV/Trailer 40 ft; six sites 35 ft; site 9 25 ft).

FCFS: recreation.gov lists all 13 sites as reservable (none FCFS); the FS page's 'Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis' boilerplate contradicts it. fcfs not written (rec.gov trusted; unreserved nights presumably walk-up).

Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed. Esri 44.2680,-71.0225: nearest pad, site 006 (44.26843,-71.02264), sits ~80 m south of the Basin Pond shore under continuous forest; the pond's day-use lot and boat launch are separate to the north-east.

PHONE: 603-447-5448 (Saco Ranger District, also recreation.gov's facility phone) is fine; recreation.gov's 'For facility specific information, please call (802) 289-0970' (concessionaire) is the optional alternative.
